verdict.rationale: Apple publishes concrete specs enabling the story: up to 64GB unified memory and 273GB/s memory bandwidth (apple-m4-pro-docs-12), plus MLX/PyTorch/Core ML tooling for on-device LLM inference (apple-m4-pro-docs-9, -8, -10) and a general marketing claim that 'LLMs and other large projects run smoothly and on device' (apple-m4-pro-docs-23). However 64GB is only just enough for a 70B model at 4-bit quantization (leaving little headroom for context/OS), and there's no first-party or independent benchmark showing actual 70B-class throughput or tokens/sec; community discussion even questions whether to buy Pro/Max specifically for local LLMs (apple-m4-pro-comm-5) without resolving it. missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark of a 70B quantized model's tokens/sec on M4 Pro, explicit vendor confirmation of 70B model support, and clarity on real-world headroom above the 64GB cap.
